name: VOT-TIR2016
description: A challenge evaluating thermal infrared visual object tracking algorithms using a curated dataset and standardized metrics.
evaluation_method: Success/AUC (overlap) and precision; robustness (failure rate) often reported
general_score_metric: AUC (Area Under Curve of overlap / success rate)
notes: Thermal-infrared domain: small/ specialized dataset relative to RGB tracking benchmarks, low contrast and modality-specific artifacts. Not an LLM benchmark; trackers may require modality-specific tuning and thermal sensors produce domain shift vs RGB datasets.
